fields.statement: At 566ff696, read the diff and ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run Scheduled and ./internal/run -run TestRunWithoutChangeSet: all pass. In a scratch repo, TestScheduledRunCommandAndWorkflow starts the command schedule intake and the repo-workflow schedule nightly (workflow tidy) with run start --schedule. Both succeed and are autonomous. Neither has a change set, worktree or branch in the started entry, and neither adds an entry to .rhiza/log. Both steps run with Dir set to the main checkout. The journal records trigger schedule and the schedule's name. run ls --json and run status --json show trigger and trigger_name with an empty change, and the run ls text says 'schedule intake'. The command's faked output reaches the run's stderr log. TestScheduledRunLeavesStepFails, on a schedule naming a copy of the built-in build workflow, and TestRunWithoutChangeSetFailsLeavesStep both fail the run with 'step "build" is a leaves step, which needs a change set', and no leaf starts. Unknown schedules and --workflow are refused. go vet and gofmt are clean, and the describe-golden testscript passes. In the full ./internal/api suite, 501 tests passed. Only TestReadBudget failed: the roadmap and ready read timings went over 50ms at VM load 25, a read path this diff does not touch. The suite then hit its timeout during TestLinkEndpointKinds.
